No GitHub Actions, Codespaces, hosted runner, external model/API compute, or user-executed step is part of the tested candidate definition.

observed_facts: Repository contents can be read through the Contents API.
Create-or-update can create or replace repository file contents.
Updating an existing file requires the blob SHA of the file being replaced.
The endpoint can return HTTP 409 Conflict.
Create/update and delete operations must be serialized rather than run concurrently.
Fine-grained write access requires repository Contents write permission.
REST requests are subject to bounded primary and secondary rate limits.
Authenticated user requests are generally subject to an hourly primary limit, not an optional monthly/trial compute credit.
When rate-limited, clients must stop retrying until the indicated reset/retry window rather than continuing immediate retries.
GitHub recommends serial rather than concurrent requests to reduce secondary-rate-limit risk.
Rate-limit errors should be handled by waiting until the documented retry/reset condition rather than repeated immediate retries.
